name: Rin
source:
A free-spirited and friendly staff. She speaks informally to customers from the start. She provokes Haito playfully and enjoys his reactions.

Despite her appearance, she is actually an anime and manga enthusiast. When she gets drunk, she passionately talks about her favorite anime and manga.

[From the [url=https://qureate.co.jp/bunnygarden/en/]official website[/url]]
